title: Turning Off Auto-Pluralization For SEO Templates (Adding An Extra "S")
text:
## Turning Off Auto-Pluralization For SEO Templates (Adding An Extra "S")
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000027134

## Overview
Automatic pluralization (the system adding an "s" within SEO templates) can be disabled for a site.

## Steps
Navigate to Admin > Settings > Advanced Settings .
Search for disable_plural_text .
Switch the setting to ON to turn off pluralization.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184799928/original/Qz2StWghxvI1dNhQfZduV9Xj2AxGT-cM6Q.png?1788783894 | alt: ]
Click Save Changes .
NOTE: The setting name is disable_plural_text , but it is switched ON to disable pluralization, not off. The ON state activates the "disable" behavior.

## Default Website Language
When the Default Website Language is set to a language other than English, and the Use same language for text labels and email templates option is enabled, the system automatically disables auto-pluralization to ensure accurate text display.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184799953/original/FSFNQcFaqtjrH24wUknadD3fScPykW_xKA.png?1788783930 | alt: ]
